title: The house

caption:
Part 2. The house is abandoned. The mailbox is brand new. 📬

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Ben found a love letter from 1975 for Thomas at 42 Wren Street, and the house was abandoned, except for a brand-new mailbox.
scenes.image: a shiny new mailbox with its red flag up before a boarded-up house in the rain

scenes.narration: A raised flag means outgoing mail. So Ben opened it.
scenes.image: a mail carrier's gloved hand opening a new metal mailbox

scenes.narration: Empty. Spotless. Not a leaf. Not a cobweb. It still smelled like the hardware store.
scenes.image: the clean empty interior of a brand-new metal mailbox, rain dripping from its lid

scenes.narration: He left Evelyn's letter inside and lowered the flag. It just felt like the right thing to do.
scenes.image: a cream envelope with a red wax seal lying inside an open mailbox

scenes.narration: At town hall, the clerk pulled the deed. 42 Wren Street. Vacant since February, 1975. Owner, a Thomas Bell. Whereabouts unknown.
scenes.image: an old manila file folder open on a wooden counter under a green banker's lamp

scenes.narration: Nobody pays for that mailbox, the clerk said. Nobody ordered it. Nobody's lived there in fifty years.
scenes.image: an older clerk peering over reading glasses across a counter in a dim records office

scenes.narration: Next morning, another letter. Same cream paper. Same red seal. Same smell of roses.
scenes.image: a second cream envelope with a red wax seal on a sorting table at dawn

scenes.narration: My dearest Thomas. You didn't write back. Are you angry with me? I'll write every day until you answer.
scenes.image: a dried red rose lying on a cream letter by candlelight, script blurred

scenes.narration: Ben drove to Wren Street before his shift. The flag was up again. Inside the box, Evelyn's first letter was gone.
scenes.image: a mailbox with its red flag raised in thick morning fog, a boarded house behind it

scenes.narration: He looked up at the house. Behind the boards, in the upstairs window, a lamp was burning. And a silhouette was reading.
scenes.image: a boarded-up Victorian house at dawn, a warm lamp glowing in one upstairs window, a silhouette behind it
